parts.title: 第貳部分：非選擇題（佔28分）

sections.title: 一、詞彙題（佔15分）
sections.instructions: 說明：第1至15題，每題選出最適當的一個選項，標示在答案卡之「選擇題答案區」。每題答對得1分，答錯不倒扣。

questions.stem: Learning to read fast is not easy; it takes _______ practice to build up a good reading habit.
The young scientist showed great _______, saying that his success was as much the result of good luck as his own talent.

reused_from.modified: gsat-88 第5題題幹為「The young scientist showed great ______ for his success. He said that it was as much the result of good luck as his own talent.」，選項 (A) dignity (B) modesty (C) intensity (D) identity，答案 B；本卷併成一句「…showed great _______, saying that his success was as much the result of good luck as his own talent.」，選項改為 dignity／intensity／humidity／modesty，答案 D（modesty）

questions.stem: The annual Grammy Awards are meant for those who _______ recognition for talent in music or for devotion to music.
In view of the students’ low academic achievement, it is time to _______ our educational system.
The guard said to us, “I apologize for the inconvenience, but I was given _______ not to let anyone in.”
As darkness _______ the ability of the rescue team, the operation at night was cancelled.
The manager is _______ all the possible marketing strategies so as to choose the most effective one.
After the accident, the drunk driver was _______ aware of what had happened.
I worked at a small company with only three full-time _______ and two part-time student workers.
The problem with Jane Smith is that she tends to take criticism too _______ and gets angry very easily.

reused_from.modified: gsat-85 第6題題幹為「The problem with Jane is that she tends to take criticism too ______ and gets angry easily.」，選項 (A) eventually (B) positively (C) intimately (D) personally；本卷改為 Jane Smith、「gets angry very easily」，選項(B) 改為 certainly，答案同為 D（personally）

questions.stem: Exercise and a good diet are _______ for people of all ages to stay healthy.
Paul _______ his position as the head coach after his team lost the championship game.
Many young people seem to have lost themselves in the _______ of fashion. They would do anything to look cool and trendy.
As their _______ over territory continues, the two countries have been in a state of war for many years.
Books can be read in different ways. As a great philosopher once noted: some are to be tasted, others to be swallowed, and some few to be chewed and _______.

groups.passage:
When it comes to personal hygiene, cats are the best example of cleanliness. They are naturally equipped with [[16]] they need to groom themselves: a flexible tongue with which to lick, forepaws they moisten with saliva and use like washcloths, and teeth to dig out tougher pieces of food. [[17]], adult cats may spend as much as half of their waking hours grooming themselves, their relatives and friends.
Mothers begin licking their kittens [[18]] birth—to clean them, stimulate the release of body waste, wake them up to suck milk, and provide comfort. Kittens usually begin grooming themselves when they are about four weeks old. [[19]] five weeks of age, kittens also begin grooming other baby cats, as well as their mom. [[20]] grooming among cats, called allogrooming, often continues into adulthood. Allogrooming is a social activity that serves to strengthen the bond between cats.

tags.topic: how cats groom themselves and each other

groups.passage:
Are you looking for a place where the waters are clear and the skies are blue, and countless stars cover the sky at night? Or would you like to [[21]] through remote and picturesque fishing villages? Then pack your bags and visit the offshore islands of Taiwan!
Taiwan is located along the southeast coast of the Asian continent, on the line [[22]] the Euro-Asian and Philippine continental plates meet. This unique geographic location and frequent earthquake activity not only created an extremely diversified landscape and natural environment on Taiwan, but also resulted [[23]] the diverse traits of its offshore islands. The main offshore islands consist of Penghu, Green Island, Orchid Island, Kinmen, Mazu, Turtle Island and Little Liuqiu. [[24]] their locations, land characteristics, and human activity differ, each has its own unique scenery and culture. Therefore, each island offers something different for visitors. [[25]] you prefer to explore nature or history, or go shopping or sport fishing, you can do it all here!

[[26]] you do not feel fully engaged after you wake up in the morning, drinking coffee at breakfast can mean the [[27]] between a productive day and never arriving at work. sections.title: 三、文意選填（佔10分）
sections.instructions: 說明：第31至40題，每題一個空格，請依文意在文章後所提供的 (A) 到 (J) 選項中分別選出最適當者，並將其英文字母代號標示在答案卡之「選擇題答案區」。每題答對得1分，答錯不倒扣。

groups.passage:
Solar energy is the most readily available source of energy. It does not belong to anybody and is, therefore, [[31]]. Of all the nonconventional sources of energy, it is the most [[32]] because it is non-polluting and helps to [[33]] the greenhouse effect.
Solar energy has been used since prehistoric times, but in a most primitive [[34]]. Before 1970, some research and development was carried out in a few countries to exploit solar energy more efficiently, but most of this [[35]] remained mainly academic. After the dramatic [[36]] in oil prices in the 1970s, several countries began to [[37]] extensive research programs to exploit solar energy.
When we hang out our clothes to [[38]] in the sun, we use the energy of the sun. In the same way, solar panels [[39]] the energy of the sun to provide heat for cooking and for heating water. Such systems are [[40]] on the market and are being used in homes and factories.

sections.title: 四、閱讀測驗（佔32分）
sections.instructions: 說明：第41至56題，每題請分別根據各篇文章之文意選出最適當的一個選項，標示在答案卡之「選擇題答案區」。每題答對得2分，答錯不倒扣。

groups.passage:
A zoo in America has announced that it will have an enclosure housing people as part of a program to demonstrate humans are part of the animal kingdom. Six people at a time will be housed in an enclosure next to the chimpanzees and gorillas, and be treated like apes. Four groups of six people will be chosen to participate in the month-long project, each group staying in the enclosure for a week. Vets will check their health and they will be given behavioral stimulation devices such as puzzles and exercise equipment. They will be fed like the zoo's other apes, with some food being hidden to encourage their food searching skills.
The Human Zoo has several aims—it will educate people about humans' place in the animal kingdom, and raise awareness of the need for conservation. Most important of all, this project is expected to generate funds for the nation's largest chimpanzee enclosure planned for Monarto Zoo next year. Psychologists also will study the behavior of the humans as they interact in their enclosure.
There will be no “<u>naked apes</u>”; the exhibits will be wearing swimsuits and have a bag-shower to cool off if the weather gets warm. If it turns chilly, they can wear sports suits.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of setting up the Human Zoo?

options.C: Less food will increase human interactions.
options.D: For humans to develop the ability to find food.

questions.stem: What does “<u>naked apes</u>” refer to?

options.A: Apes that live next to humans.
options.B: Humans that are not wearing clothes.
options.C: Gorillas that belong to the ape family.
options.D: Apes and humans that participate in the project.

groups.passage:
People are attracted to a restaurant by more than just good food. Equally important is the way people feel while in the restaurant. Their physical and emotional response is a result of the atmosphere—the total environment to which customers are exposed. Atmosphere is made up of the building design, decoration, interior color scheme, texture of the walls, and service. If the guests relax and have a good feeling, the proper atmosphere can make the food, service and whole dining experience seem better.
People want to escape from their problems and everyday surroundings. Thus the atmosphere should project friendliness and comfort, be attractive and interesting. The atmosphere is remembered long after the meal is finished. For the restaurant owner, this means repeat customers and, hopefully, a <u>profitable operation</u>.
Not everyone wants the same restaurant atmosphere. After working all day, most people prefer to eat in a quiet, relaxed, intimate atmosphere. However, for those who work alone in a quiet environment, a noisy cafeteria might provide needed contrast. It is, therefore, very important to be familiar with the characteristics of the people you wish to serve.
People perceive such primary factors as sight, touch, smell, hearing, temperature, and tempo. Together these combine to make the atmosphere. Designing the “right” atmosphere takes careful consideration. The total atmosphere and operation of the restaurant should be geared in a special way. They need to attract the largest number possible from the target group.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the most important sign of a good atmosphere in a restaurant?
A noisy restaurant may be suitable for people who ________.

options.D: are used to working with other people

questions.stem: What does “<u>profitable operation</u>” mean in this passage?
What is the most important consideration in designing the “right” atmosphere?

options.B: Knowing who the target customers are.
options.C: Finding a good location for the restaurant.
options.D: Designing the interior of the restaurant carefully.

groups.passage: George Leigh Mallory (1886-1924) was a British pioneering mountaineer, who was engaged in early attempts to conquer the world’s tallest mountain, Everest. He participated in three British attempts in 1921, 1922 and 1924. In the 1922 expedition, he reached a height of 27,000 feet. He retreated due to an avalanche (snow slide) in which seven Sherpa climbers lost their lives. The 1924 climb was his final one. Mallory and his partner, Sandy Irvine, departed from the high camp on June 8. They were even seen by geologist Noel Odell during a short break in the blowing snow as they moved toward the Second Step. After that there was no news of them—they were lost in the vast North Face of Everest. In 1960 Chinese climbers completed the same route that Mallory and Irvine attempted. A Chinese climber reportedly found a body believed to be Irvine’s at that time. In 1999 American climber Conrad Anker found the frozen body of Mallory at 26,760 feet. A positive identification was made by Mallory’s name label on the torn clothing. The appearance of Mallory’s body has again heated up the debate. Did Mallory and Irvine first reach the peak of Everest? Or did Sir Edmund Hillary and Sherpa Tenzing Norgay reach the summit in June of 1953 as is officially cited? While that debate continues, there is one thing that is certain—in March 1923, a reporter from The New York Times interviewed George Mallory. He asked Mallory, “Why do you want to climb Mount Everest?” His reply has become famous; he said, “Because it’s there.”

questions.stem: According to the passage, who was the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest?
Why did Mallory fail in his second attempt to climb Mount Everest?

options.B: The real reason is not known.
options.C: He was not assisted by Sherpa climbers.
options.D: He lost contact with Sandy Irvine.

questions.stem: What issue was raised by the finding of Mallory’s body?

options.A: Why did he want to climb Mount Everest?
options.B: How difficult is it to climb Mount Everest?
options.C: How high had he reached on Mount Everest?
options.D: Who was the first to reach the top of Mount Everest?

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true?

options.A: Mallory was determined to conquer Mount Everest.
options.B: Noel Odell joined Mallory to climb Mount Everest.
options.C: Mallory’s body was discovered by Chinese climbers.
options.D: Chinese climbers first reached the summit of Everest.

tags.topic: George Mallory and the debate over the first ascent of Everest

groups.passage:
Philosophy is not a subject but an activity. You don’t study it; you do it. To be a philosopher, therefore, you need not be an academic, or an expert on the history of the practice of philosophy. However, you do need to think and argue in a particular way. You might already be a philosopher without knowing it.
The word “philosophy,” which means “love of knowledge,” comes from the Greek language. The earliest philosophers among the ancient Greeks were also mathematicians and scientists. These were people who had the tendency and also, crucially, the time to seek knowledge, because they had slaves to do all of the labor work.
Broadly speaking, there are two tasks for philosophers. The first is to search for truth. However, many philosophers say they don’t know what the word “truth” means, while other philosophers don’t think it exists at all. The search for truth is not the central concern of most academic philosophers, but that doesn’t mean everyone else shouldn’t <u>have a go</u> at it.
The second task is about the application of logical thinking to everyday questions, concepts, and ideas that are often taken for granted. This kind of conceptual analysis serves to clarify debate over the meaning of such concepts as justice, knowledge, and human nature. There is no point arguing about justice, knowledge, perception, or human nature unless we have some idea about what kind of things these terms might mean.

questions.stem: According to the passage, a philosopher needs to ________.

options.D: have a special way of thinking

questions.stem: The phrase “<u>have a go</u>” in Paragraph 3 can best be replaced by “________.”
According to the passage, what is the major concern of philosophers?
Which of the following statements is true?

options.A: There are two kinds of philosophers.
options.B: People in the past liked to do labor work.
options.C: Philosophers agree on the definition of justice.
options.D: Many people are unaware that they are philosophers.

tags.topic: what philosophy is and the two tasks of philosophers

sections.title: 一、中譯英（佔8分）
sections.instructions:
說明：1.下面一段短文中，有數處係以中文呈現，請利用上下文線索（如單字、片語等）將其譯成正確、通順、達意且前後連貫的英文，並將答案寫在「答案卷」上。

groups.passage:
My grandfather had a habit of taking a walk every morning along a road nearby. Kind drivers frequently stopped to ask if he needed a ride. The offers disturbed his enjoyment of peace, <u>1.所以我爺爺就開始帶著一個裝滿空罐子和垃圾的大袋子</u> when he went for a walk. Afterward no one bothered him anymore.
One day as my grandfather headed out with his bag, a truck drove by and slowed down. “Not again,” my grandfather thought. <u>2.當他正要告訴駕駛他不需要任何幫忙的時候,</u> five beer cans flew out the window, and the truck sped off.

sections.instructions:
說明：1.依提示在「答案卷」上寫一篇英文作文。

questions.label: 英文作文
questions.stem: 提示：請以下列四張圖畫內容為藍本，依序寫一篇文章，描述兩個學生在圖書館的尷尬經驗。請注意，故事內容務必涵蓋四張圖意，力求情節完整、前後發展合理。
questions.scoring_notes:
英文作文評分指標（考試說明 other-3.pdf「學科能力測驗英文考科考試說明」〔中華民國九十六年九月〕印刷頁碼第8頁〔PDF 第10頁〕；考試說明所列之一般評分指標，非本參考試卷專屬的評分原則。表格依「項目：等級（分數）＝描述」轉成文字）
內容：優（5-4分）＝主題(句)清楚切題，並有具體、完整的相關細節支持。／可（3分）＝主題不夠清楚或突顯，部分相關敘述發展不全。／差（2-1分）＝主題不明，大部分相關敘述發展不全或與主題無關。／劣（0分）＝文不對題或沒寫(凡文不對題或沒寫者，其他各項均以零分計算)。
組織：優（5-4分）＝重點分明，有開頭、發展、結尾，前後連貫，轉承語使用得當。／可（3分）＝重點安排不妥，前後發展比例與轉承語使用欠妥。／差（2-1分）＝重點不明、前後不連貫。／劣（0分）＝全文毫無組織或未按提示寫作。
文法、句構：優（4分）＝全文幾無文法錯誤，文句結構富變化。／可（3分）＝文法錯誤少，且未影響文意之表達。／差（2-1分）＝文法錯誤多，且明顯影響文意之表達。／劣（0分）＝全文文法錯誤嚴重，導致文意不明。
字彙、拼字：優（4分）＝用字精確、得宜，且幾無拼字錯誤。／可（3分）＝字詞單調、重複，用字偶有不當，少許拼字錯誤，但不影響文意之表達。／差（2-1分）＝用字、拼字錯誤多，明顯影響文意之表達。／劣（0分）＝只寫出或抄襲與題意有關的零碎字詞。
體例：優、可（2分，原表兩欄合併）＝格式、標點、大小寫幾無錯誤。／差（1分）＝格式、標點、大小寫等有錯誤，但不影響文意之表達。／劣（0分）＝違背基本的寫作體例或格式，標點、大小寫等錯誤甚多。
（考試說明對英文作文的作答說明：依提示在「答案卷」上寫一篇英文作文。文長約 100 至 120 個單詞（words），作答內容請寫在「答案卷」上。本參考試卷沒有公布範文或本題專屬的評分原則。）

issues: 檔案拆分：units.json 的 ref-98 含兩份不同試卷——paper-1.pdf「指定科目考試參考試卷 英文考科」（答案 answer-1.pdf）與 paper-2.pdf「學科能力測驗參考試卷 英文考科」（答案 answer-2.pdf）。依同年多份試卷的規則分別輸出 ref-98-a（指考參考試卷）與 ref-98-b（學測參考試卷），比照 ref-102-a／b。exam 都填 reference，year 填 98（units.json 檔案標題為「95課綱(98年施測)…參考試卷公告」）。題本封面只印「大學入學考試中心／學科能力測驗參考試卷／英文考科」，title 中「（適用於95課綱）」是依 units.json 檔案標題補上的。

結構核對（gsat-spec.json legacy_gsat「94–110」期別，本卷為95課綱學測參考試卷）：大題、題數與配分都與題本一致——詞彙題1–15（各1分）、綜合測驗16–30（3篇×5題，各1分）、文意選填31–40（10個選項(A)–(J)，各1分）、閱讀測驗41–56（4篇×4題，各2分）、中譯英2題各4分、英文作文20分；第壹部分72分＋第貳部分28分＝100分。封面「題型題數：第壹部分 單一選擇題共 56 題；第貳部分 非選擇題共 2 大題」「選擇題答錯不倒扣」與內文一致，與 spec multiple_choice_penalty「83–99學年度題本皆載明「答錯不倒扣」」相同；考試時間100分鐘（封面）。內文部分標題為「第壹部分：選擇題（佔72分）」，所以 part 填「選擇題」。

結構差異（以題本為準）：(1) 大題名稱用「詞彙題」「中譯英」，98學年度正式學測則為「詞彙」「翻譯題」（spec：100起改稱中譯英、102起改稱詞彙題）。(2) 中譯英採「克漏式翻譯」——一篇英文短文中有兩處劃線的中文要譯成英文（考試說明 other-3.pdf 也把克漏式翻譯列為可能題型），與94–110正式學測的兩個獨立中文句子不同（100–110見 spec translation_format_note；94–99依 parsed gsat-94～99 核對，皆為2個獨立句子）。(3) 作文文長「約100至120個單詞」，spec essay_length_by_year 記載96–98正式學測為「120個單詞(words)左右」（100學年度才是約100至120）；本卷作文為四格看圖作文。
統計：參考試卷沒有正式施測，units.json 沒有 stats 檔，repo 中也找不到本卷的答對率或鑑別度，所以所有小題的 stats 都是 null，sources.stats 為空陣列；validator 的「整份考卷沒有任何統計資料」warning 由此而來，屬預期。沿用自歷屆試題的第2、10題也沒有把原考試的統計複製過來（題目已改寫）。

答案來源：選擇題1–56取自 answer-2.pdf「學科能力測驗參考試卷 英文考科選擇題參考答案」（pdftotext 與頁面影像逐題核對一致）。官方只公布選擇題答案，沒有中譯英參考譯文，也沒有評分原則檔（units.json 沒有 scoring，sources.scoring 為空陣列），所以中譯英第1、2題的 answer／accepted_answers／scoring_notes 都是 null；作文 answer 依 schema 為 null。

作文 scoring_notes：收錄考試說明 other-3.pdf「學科能力測驗英文考科考試說明」（中華民國九十六年九月，適用九五課綱）的「英文作文評分指標」表（內容、組織各5分，文法句構、字彙拼字各4分，體例2分；以 250dpi 放大看頁面影像確認，表格依「項目：等級（分數）＝描述」轉成文字，「體例」列優、可兩欄在原表合併；原表「全文幾無文法錯誤， 文句結構富變化」逗號後的多餘空格已去除），並註明這是考試說明的一般評分指標，不是本卷專屬的評分原則，與 ref-102 的做法相同。

來源檔：other-3.pdf 與 other-4.pdf 是同一份檔案（md5 相同，都是「學科能力測驗英文考科考試說明」），只列 other-3.pdf；other-1.pdf／other-2.pdf（指考考試說明，兩檔相同）用於 ref-98-a。考試說明的「試題舉例」全部取自歷屆試題（92／94／96學測，84／85／87學測改編，英文寫作能力測驗規劃研究 VI），沒有收錄本參考試卷的任何題目，所以無法用來核對本卷答案。

沿用的歷屆試題（以 8-gram 比對 data/raw/ceec 下學測83–115、指考91–110全部題本 paper-1.pdf 與 parsed JSON）：第2題改寫自 gsat-88 第5題（原答案 B modesty，本卷併成一句並更換選項，答案 D modesty）、第10題改寫自 gsat-85 第6題（原 Jane→Jane Smith、gets angry easily→very easily、選項(B) positively→certainly，答案同為 D personally）。以擴充欄位 reused_from 標示並寫明差異（比照 ref-102、ref-111、ref-115）；tags 與原題一致（第2題 word_meaning／noun，第10題 collocation／adverb／take criticism personally）。其餘選文與題目在 repo 的歷屆題本中都沒有找到。
題本排版照原樣保留：第8題題號後沒有句點（文字層與頁面影像都是「8   After the accident…」），label 仍為「8」。第41–44題選文 zoo's、humans'、nation's 為直撇號（文字層與影像一致），其他選文為彎撇號 ’，照原樣保留。

空格與排版：克漏字類選文的空格在 PDF 是底線加題號，轉成 [[題號]] 後去除底線排版造成的多餘空白，空格後緊接標點時不留空格（例如「[[17]], adult cats」「is, therefore, [[31]]. Of all」「primitive [[34]]. Before 1970」）；第27題（「the__27__between」）與第30題（「and__30__ them」）題本中底線緊貼前後字，統一寫成「the [[27]] between」「and [[30]] them」。題組前的「第 16 至 20 題爲題組」等標示沒有放進 passage。段落依頁面影像的首行縮排切分，以換行分隔（第16–20、21–25、26–30題各2段，第31–40題4段，第41–44題3段，第45–48題4段，第49–52題1段，第53–56題4段）。

畫底線的字：第44題問 “naked apes”、第47題問 “profitable operation”、第54題問 “have a go”，三者在選文與題幹中都印成粗體加底線，依 schema 原則在 passage 與 stem 中都標成 <u>…</u>（比照 gsat-96、gsat-97 的做法）。其他格式不保留：第49–52題選文的 The New York Times 為斜體；中譯英短文的 “Not again,” 為斜體。

中譯英（克漏式翻譯）：題本為兩段英文短文，其中兩處劃線的中文即第1、2題。group passage 保留整篇短文，劃線部分以 <u>…</u> 標出並含句首題號（看頁面影像確認：第1處底線延伸到 when 前的空格，第2處底線含句末逗號）；各題 stem 為去掉題號的中文，標點照原文（第2題句末是半形逗號「,」，與後面英文 five beer cans… 接續）。短文第1段第1處中文在 PDF 中跨行（「1.所以我爺爺／就開始帶著…」），已以程式核對併回一行後與文字層一致。
作文圖片：提示要求依四張圖畫內容寫故事，四格漫畫以 figures 四筆（label 1–4）分格描述；畫中文字只有圖1對話框中的「Home?」「Library?」。圖4中間搔頭的男孩是否就是原本與女孩同桌的男孩，畫面沒有明說（髮型相同、但沒有畫出圖1–3那樣的圓框），描述中只寫畫面所見並註明兩人已不坐在一起。
說明文字：大題標題在 PDF 中是字距加寬排版（如「一 、 詞 彙 題 （ 佔 15 分 ）」），title 去除了這些排版空白，並照題本用「佔」字。各大題說明與「提示：」的冒號為「：」(U+FF1A)；文意選填說明「(A) 到 (J)」前後的空白照文字層保留。中譯英、作文說明的兩點以換行分開。第壹、第貳部分標題放在擴充欄位 parts（與 ref-102 相同做法）。
題號：中譯英在題本印為 1.、2.，作文沒有題號；schema 要求 no 為整數，所以中譯英 no＝1、2，作文 no＝1，label 寫成「中譯英1」「中譯英2」「英文作文」，以免和詞彙題1、2重複（與 ref-102、ref-110 相同做法）。validator 的「題號重複 [1, 2]」warning 由此而來，屬預期。

標註判斷：第16題 everything（後接冒號列舉舌頭、前掌、牙齒三樣工具）標 discourse／pronoun；第17題 Believe it or not 標 connective／phrase（比照既有檔案的轉承片語）；第22題 where 引導關係子句修飾 the line，標 grammar／relative_clause，answer_pos 依既有檔案（ast-108、gsat-107）填 adverb；第25題 Whether…or… 標 connective（比照 gsat-103）；第28題 thereby causing 標 grammar／participle；第31、35題要靠上下文（不屬於任何人→free；research and development→work）判斷，標 discourse。閱讀：第44題問 “naked apes” 指誰，標 reference；第47、54題標 vocab_in_context；第48、49、52、55題需推論，標 inference；其餘為 detail。sdgs：咖啡因 [3]、太陽能 [7, 13]、人類動物園（保育、黑猩猩園區募款）[15]；其他為 []。

查證（verifier）：獨立重新核對，題目內容未發現錯誤，只修正下列說明文字。(1) 第1–56題答案逐題對照 answer-2.pdf（文字層＋頁面影像）全部一致。(2) 全卷題幹、(A)–(D)選項與文意選填(A)–(J)選項庫，以英文詞序列與 -raw 文字層整卷逐詞比對完全一致（2,800 詞，差異只有大題標題、題組標示與第8題題號後無句點），選項字母對位正確；詞彙題7個底線、閱讀題幹8個底線與文字層相同。(3) 9篇選文（含中譯英短文）逐字元比對全部一致（首句、末句、空格後標點、zoo's 等直撇號皆同），字數 144/163/132/187/207/238/261/239/81 與 pdftotext 擷取相同，段落數 2/2/2/4/3/4/1/4/2 與頁面影像首行縮排一致，[[16]]–[[40]] 位置與影像相符；naked apes、profitable operation、have a go 在選文與題幹都是粗體加底線，<u> 標示正確。(4) 大題標題、各大題說明、中譯英兩處中文、作文說明與提示都是文字層的逐字子字串；作文評分指標表看 other-3.pdf 第10頁影像核對，與 other-1.pdf 同一張表內容相同。(5) 四格漫畫以 300dpi 逐格裁切重看，四筆 figures 描述與畫面相符；修正兩處超出畫面的推論：圖1「討論要在家裡還是去圖書館讀書」→「商量要待在家裡還是去圖書館」（畫面沒有畫出讀書）；圖2「紙上只有塗鴉」→「紙上只有潦草的鋸齒狀線條（看起來像塗鴉）」。(6) 結構差異說明修正兩處引用：spec multiple_choice_penalty 原文是「83–99學年度題本皆載明「答錯不倒扣」」，原寫成「86–99題本皆載明答錯不倒扣」；translation_format_note 只涵蓋100–110學年度，94–99學年度為兩個獨立中文句子這點改以 parsed gsat-94～99 核對（皆無 passage、各2句）。(7) 參考試卷沒有統計檔，stats 全為 null，無法抽查答對率。(8) 沿用題以 7-gram 重新搜尋，只找到第2題（gsat-88 第5題）與第10題（gsat-85 第6題），其餘命中只有「Which of the following statements is true?」這類通用題幹；reused_from 內容與 gsat-88、gsat-85 parsed JSON 一致。(9) tags 逐題檢查，未發現明顯錯誤。
